url: chrome-extension://chrome-agent-platform (MV3 extension; audited via chrome-extension:// pages)
statusDetail: 11 findings (2 high memory-leaks, 1 high dark-scheme, 1 high narrow-overflow, 4 medium, 3 low); core task flow + performance + security posture pass.
evidenceUsed: evaluate (axe-core, focus, computed styles, memory metrics)

config.note: no web-uplift.json in the repo; judged per principle with extension-form-factor context

principleOutcomes.reason: color-scheme ignored (F3); reduced-motion respected (media query in ntp.html + matchMedia gate).
Panels/dialogs animate with transitions; Escape closes panels (verified); sidebar collapse toggle persists. No scroll-driven/gesture-dependent patterns expected of a utility extension.
First-run guide gives a strong 3-step path, but the disabled CTA hides WHY (F5); settings back-stack is one-press by design (verified: #appearance → back → #about) — pass on that axis.
No intrusive interruptions; onboarding is dismissible; dialogs are semantic and dismissible; hub density is low at wide viewports (cosmetic, F10 as low).
360px overflow on all NTP surfaces (F4); fixed 680px column reads sparse at 1440px (F10); sidepanel adapts fine.
Core run flow works end-to-end when a provider is configured, but failure paths are weak (F8) and the first-run CTA hides its gating (F5); artifact error state has a dead action (F9).
NTP cold load: FCP 24.4ms, DCL 38.3ms, 0 long tasks in a 6s trace (perf.json); CLS observed 0 across surfaces; zoom 200% reflows without overflow.
axe violations incl. 1 critical aria-allowed-attr on NTP + 3 on options; no H1; duplicate/nested landmarks (F6, F7). Focus-visible outlines present on nav (keyboard.json); zoom reflow passes.
Zero console errors on every audited surface (12+ pages, normal + emulated conditions); valid titles everywhere; no mixed content.
Extension pages are not crawled/indexed; chrome_url_overrides + sidepanel registration are the correct discovery channels for this form factor.

chrome.storage-local key story stated in-product; web_accessible_resources is the minimal artifact-viewer set (artifact.html/js + sandbox frame only); hostile-id probe renders inert text (the 0.2.318 fix verified); no third-party network calls observed from pages.

Honest empty states (artifacts library, tasks, activity); 12s-timeout + Retry hardening landed previously; offline is inherent (local runtime). Resilient-runtime behaviour verified via zero uncaught exceptions across probes.
Single-locale product today; locale plumbing exists but content is en-only. Re-audit when localisation lands.
Failed dispatches vanish instead of surfacing a persistent, retryable failure (F8); browser-control consent is explicitly asked in onboarding (good).
All assets ship locally in the bundle; no third-party requests; total bundle weight is the store-package's concern (separate scan).
The product IS an agent runtime: 130 browser tools, site-agent discovery, structured routes — the principle's intent is satisfied by design.
Frame/document/listener leaks on panel open/close (F1, F2); bounded-footprint otherwise (heap 3.2MB baseline).

paths.why: first-run state (fresh profile) — the highest-traffic first journey
iframe panel views (settings/directory/assets) — the leak + navigation surfaces

findings.summary: Settings/directory/assets panels leak their iframe documents and frames on repeated open/close: Documents 12→33 and Frames 11→21 after 20 open/close cycles (Performance.getMetrics); close-button path alone: Documents 5→15, Frames 3→8 after 5 closes.
findings.evidence: CDP Performance.getMetrics before/after repeated panel cycles (memory2.json, leak-compare.json). Heap grew 3.2MB→7.2MB over the same window.
findings.suggestedFix: On panel close, remove the iframe from the DOM and null its src (or reuse a single persistent frame per view); audit the panel-close path for retained frame owners (the view wrapper keeps references after hide).

findings.summary: Event listeners accumulate on panel open/close: JSEventListeners 113→334 after 5 open/Escape cycles, and 240→479 over the 20-cycle sweep — listeners are added per open and never removed.
findings.suggestedFix: Wire panel-scoped listeners with AbortController/once and tear them down on close; verify with the same metrics probe (listener count must return to baseline after close).

findings.summary: No surface responds to prefers-color-scheme: dark — every audited page keeps the light palette (body bg rgb(247,246,243)) under OS dark mode: NTP (all views), options, sidepanel, artifact viewer, artifacts library, directory.
findings.evidence: Emulated prefers-color-scheme: dark screenshots + computed body background on every surface (surfaces.json darkSample; *-dark.png artifacts).
findings.suggestedFix: Add a dark scheme to the single design system (theme.css): define tokens with light-dark() or a prefers-color-scheme media query; audit contrast in both schemes. Context: theme switching was deliberately removed, but OS-level scheme respect is a user preference, not a theme switcher.

findings.summary: Horizontal overflow (16px) on every NTP surface at 360px (hub, first-run, and the settings/directory/assets panels): the fixed 240px sidebar rail is not auto-collapsed at narrow widths, leaving ~120px of content column; the first-run card wraps one word per line and clips at the right edge.
findings.evidence: layoutMetrics overflowX=16 at 360x800 on ntp-firstrun/hub/chat/directory/settings (surfaces.json); ntp-hub-dark.png (captured at 360px) shows the clipped card.
findings.suggestedFix: Auto-collapse the rail below 600px (matchMedia listener + the existing collapsed state), or convert it to an overlay drawer; re-run the 360px overflow probe (target 0).

findings.summary: The first-run guide's primary CTA ("Use starter task") renders disabled with no accessible reason: no title, no aria-disabled, no aria-describedby; storageReady/providerReady gating is invisible to the user and to assistive tech.
findings.evidence: first-run-guide shadow DOM probe (leak-compare.json cta): {disabled:true, title:null, ariaDisabled:null, describedBy:null, storageReady:false, providerReady:false}; ntp-hub-normal.png shows the greyed button.
findings.suggestedFix: When gated, keep the button enabled-looking but present the reason inline ("Configure a provider to unlock") or set aria-describedby pointing at the gating explanation; also expose it as a status line so screen readers announce it.

findings.summary: axe-core violations on primary surfaces: aria-allowed-attr (1 node on NTP; 3 on options pages — elements with unsupported ARIA attributes), landmark-unique (NTP), nested-interactive (NTP panels), scrollable-region-focusable (options), landmark-one-main + region role issues (sidepanel, artifact viewer).
findings.evidence: axe.run() on ntp/options/sidepanel/artifact (surfaces.json axe blocks); passes 38 on NTP.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix the aria-allowed-attr elements first (critical impact), give duplicate/nested landmarks distinct accessible names, make scrollable regions tabbable (tabindex=0 + label).

findings.summary: No level-one heading on the NTP (page-has-heading-one; heading order starts at H2: Agents / Recent artifacts / Recent activity) — the page title lives in <title> only.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a visually-integrated h1 (e.g. "Agent Hub") or promote the brand element to h1; keep the visual design unchanged.

findings.summary: A run that fails before dispatch (no provider configured; demo model returned no content) leaves NO trace in Tasks (task.list stays empty) — the user's submit silently produces nothing persistent; recovery requires re-entering the prompt.
findings.evidence: seed.json + run2.json: named-agent.run → {ok:false,error:"the model returned no content"} and the composer run probe → tasks:[], runs:[] with no visible status on the surfaces probed.
findings.suggestedFix: Persist failed dispatches as a task row with an explicit failed state + Retry, or surface an inline persistent error card in the thread area. (Medium confidence: probes may have missed transient status text.)

findings.summary: The artifact viewer's "Copy content" action is enabled even in the error state (no artifact id given) — a dead primary-adjacent action on the failure path.
findings.evidence: artifact-noid-normal.png: error text "No artifact id given." with an enabled Copy content button; hostile-id render confirmed inert (imgs:0 bold:0 — the 0.2.318 escaping fix holds).
findings.suggestedFix: Disable Copy content (and Back-only layout) until an artifact resolves.

findings.summary: The hub content column is hard-capped at max-width:680px, leaving ~700px of dead margins at 1440×900; the settings panel shows the same 680px column inside a full-viewport iframe. Content is not harmed, but the hub reads sparse and panels waste half the dialog.
findings.suggestedFix: Let the hub grid use the available width (e.g. 2-column agent/activity layout ≥1100px) or cap at ~960px; consider widening the settings column to ~840px.

findings.summary: Sidepanel first-run is extremely sparse: a wrapped "Side panel" label, one URL row, and a one-line hint over an empty viewport — no guidance about what Site Agents do or what to do first; landmark-one-main + region axe violations.
findings.evidence: sidepanel-narrow.png / sidepanel2.json (text + interactive inventory); axe violations landmark-one-main, region:2.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a compact getting-started block (what Site Agents are, one example) and fix the label/landmark structure.

taskList.task: Fix the panel iframe/listener leak: release or reuse frames on close; tear down listeners (AbortController); verify with the metrics probe (Documents/Frames/JSEventListeners return to baseline).
Add a prefers-color-scheme: dark scheme to the single design system (light-dark() tokens + contrast audit in both schemes).
Kill the 360px overflow: auto-collapse the sidebar rail <600px (or overlay drawer); re-probe overflowX=0 on all NTP surfaces.
Make the first-run CTA gating visible: inline reason + aria-describedby; keep the numbered steps as the anchor.
Persist failed dispatches as visible, retryable task rows (or a persistent inline error card).
Clear the axe violations: aria-allowed-attr (critical) on NTP + options, landmark names, tabbable scrollable regions, add an H1.
Artifact viewer: disable Copy content in the error state.
Wide-viewport density: hub ≥1100px two-column (or 960px cap); widen the settings column inside panels.

artifacts.caption: DevTools performance trace of NTP cold load (summary inline in perf.json)

budget.notCovered: A task thread WITH real history could not be seeded: no provider credentials in the clean profile, the built-in demo model returned no content in two attempts, so thread-open timing (the 0.2.317 bounded-replay fix) is NOT re-verified end-to-end here; the empty thread/tasks states were audited instead. Service-worker + shared-worker heaps were not profiled (page-level metrics only).
